title: The halves open like doors · frame 3
prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLES:
— the previous frame of this storyboard. BASE IMAGE: edit it as instructed; everything the instruction does not change stays exactly as it is.
— a gold emblem on black: an open circle broken at the upper right, crossed by a level bar and a steep slanted bar that meet in a small stepped block. OBJECT REFERENCE: this is the Thoughtform brand mark. Reproduce its shape exactly, engraved into the top face of the central gold dot plate, lying flat on the plate and foreshortened with it.

FRAME 3 OF 4. Edit the base image. Keep exactly: the camera, the near-black ground, the palette (bone white, muted gold, sage green only), the hairline line weight, the square-dot language of the plates, and the gold central plate with the engraved Thoughtform mark in the same place and size. No words or letters anywhere. Change one thing: the halves are fully open, moved out to the far left and far right of the frame and turned to face the viewer as two tall curved panels; their etched plans reorganise into neat horizontal rows of dots. The gold mark plate stands alone at the centre, now the largest and brightest thing in the frame.
